result.summary: Fixes an intermittent test failure in wallet_fast_rescan.py by ensuring block filter indexes are synced before rescanning. It also refactors test node startup and block-mining helpers to wait for index synchronization by default across the functional test suite.
result.problem: Functional tests that rely on background indexing threads can race with wallet operations, leading to intermittent failures (such as missing block filters during fast rescan) when index processing is delayed.
evidence: Fixes issue #36564 where fast rescan fails if index sync lags behind ("WARNING: block filter not found!"), reproducible by adding thread startup delays (PR description).
Commit message notes that test helpers already wait for mempool and block sync after startup and mining, making index sync standard to avoid intermittent failures across tests.
result.scope_notes: Modifies test framework helpers across 18 test files to wait for index sync by default rather than manually per test.
result.card: This pull request fixes intermittent test failures caused by race conditions between wallet rescans and background index synchronization. By making test framework helpers wait for index sync by default after node startup and block generation, it eliminates test flakes like the one documented in issue #36564 where fast rescan fails due to missing block filters. The change touches test infrastructure across 18 test files with no production code modifications.

risk.why: Only touches Python functional test infrastructure and test cases, so a bug would cause test timeouts or false test failures in CI.
